purpose: Teach: 中曽根/ドール/ジョーンズ/サード/ハリス/菅/内藤/ダニエル

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、中曽根政権の経済政策の論文を読め
lines.en: Ren, read the paper on economic policy from the Nakasone administration.
lines.style: Direct and clipped. Not unkind, but no wasted breath. Sets expectation with firm clarity. The tone of someone who has already seen the work you're capable of.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。米国ドール社の農業ビジネス論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through the US Dole Corporation agricultural business paper.
lines.style: Quick affirmation, eager to show readiness. Slight rise at the end—confirming he's understood and ready to move. Genuine, not performative.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、英国学界のジョーンズ教授に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren, contact Professor Jones at the UK academic institution for a research inquiry.
lines.style: Same measured tempo as the first line. Practical, no elaboration. The slight pause before the name signals this is someone specific and important.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。サードパーティ評価制度の論文を読みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read the third-party evaluation system paper.
lines.style: Efficient acknowledgment. A beat shorter than before—he's already moving mentally to the next task. Focused, not breathless.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、米国のハリス研究所と連携しろ
lines.en: Ren, establish a collaboration with the Harris Research Institute in the US.
lines.style: Same directorial tone, slightly lower in register. Each task builds on the last—the cadence suggests this is part of a larger trajectory he's designed for you.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。指導の菅先生のご研究を継承します
lines.en: Yes. I'll build on the research my advisor Professor Suga has established.
lines.style: Respectful nod to the lineage. Not submissive—confident that he understands the foundation. Clear and steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の内藤先生に資料を共有しろ
lines.en: Ren, share the materials with Professor Naito on the joint research project.
lines.style: The final instruction in a series. Slight settling quality to the voice—you can hear the plan coming together. Still direct, but with the weight of completion beginning to land.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外研究員ダニエル氏に英文要約を送ります
lines.en: Yes. I'll send an English summary to Daniel, the overseas research fellow.
lines.style: The last affirmation. Calm, capable. He's absorbed all the direction and is already executing. No hesitation—just quiet competence taking shape.
